# Sheffield - council briefing
*Auto-generated from council minutes, 20 May 2026 to 18 August 2026*

## What's dominating the agenda
The top topics are licensing & regulation (4720 mentions), finance & budget (4425 mentions), and transport & highways (2949 mentions). The Statutory, Licensing Sub-Committee and Finance and Performance Policy Committee committees are driving most agenda items in this period.

## Notable decisions
- A new Built Facilities Strategy for Sport and Leisure — the city's first — was approved as a key decision (15 Jul).
- Next steps for the refreshed Green and Open Spaces Strategy were confirmed, following the Task and Finish Group's work (15 Jul).

## Projects on residents' radar
- **Sheffield Markets Strategy** - a Year 1 update on the strategy to modernise the city's markets and put them on a more sustainable financial footing was presented to committee (20 Mar). [source](https://democracy.sheffield.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=4934)
- **PlayZones project, Ecclesfield Park** - the council withdrew from this play-area improvement scheme after cost increases made it unviable, reassigning the match funding to other community projects (2 Feb). [source](https://democracy.sheffield.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=4835)
- **Endcliffe Lodge, Endcliffe Park** - the committee considered entering lease negotiations with a recommended operator for the lodge, following a marketing exercise (9 Mar). [source](https://democracy.sheffield.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=4898)
- **A625 Safer Roads Scheme** - the council responded to consultation objections on the proposed Traffic Regulation Order and Speed Limit Order for this road safety scheme (28 Jan). [source](https://democracy.sheffield.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=4820)
- **Advanced Zoning Programme heat network** - the Transport, Regeneration and Climate Policy Committee approved a procurement strategy to appoint a heat network developer as part of Sheffield's participation in the government's Advanced Zoning Programme (18 Mar). [source](https://democracy.sheffield.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=4932)
